# Osteoperionews

> Weekly curated English & Italian summaries of peer-reviewed periodontology, dental-implantology and peri-implant research, by Dr. Ernesto Bruschi (periodontist, implantologist, oral surgeon; ORCID 0000-0002-4773-5384). Each entry is an original short summary of a peer-reviewed paper that links to the primary source (DOI and PubMed). English pages are under /en, Italian under /it.

- Site: https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com
- Author: Dr. Ernesto Bruschi — https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4773-5384
- Feeds: https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/feed.xml (EN), https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/feed-it.xml (IT)
- Full archive: https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles (EN), https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/it/articles (IT)

## Articles

- [Save the tooth or replace it? In the Swedish cohort, it depends on the site](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/root-canal-treatment-vs-implants-survival-and-costs-in-a-national-cohort-42641863): In brief: Swedish national cohort, over 16,000 propensity-matched patients, followed up to 9 years — Journal of dentistry (DOI: 10.1016/j.jdent.2026.107000)
- [ARP vs GBR: no single technique wins across all defects](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/optimizing-alveolar-ridge-preservation-and-gbr-a-systematic-review-of-membranes-42639343): In brief: Systematic review of 14 RCTs on alveolar ridge preservation (ARP) and guided bone regeneration (GBR) — International journal of dentistry (DOI: 10.1155/ijod/3754780)
- [Peri-implantitis surgery: submerged or not matters less than the patient in front of you](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/surgical-reconstructive-therapy-of-peri-implantitis-via-submerged-versus-non-sub-42677858): In brief: 2-year retrospective study, 33 patients and 53 implants treated with reconstructive surgery for peri-implantitis — Clinical implant dentistry and related research (DOI: 10.1111/cid.70182)
- [In Switzerland, edentulism among seniors fell from 44% to 4% in 40 years](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/oral-health-and-functioning-in-older-adults-in-switzerland-from-1970-to-2025-a-s-42686922): In brief: Meta-analysis of over 50 years of Swiss data on oral health in adults 65+ — Clinical oral investigations (DOI: 10.1007/s00784-026-07105-1)
- [An RNA-binding protein decides if stem cells build bone or fat](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/rna-binding-protein-otud1-maintains-skeletal-homeostasis-by-determining-mesenchy-42671913): In brief: In mice, OTUD1 stabilizes BMP2 mRNA and pushes mesenchymal stem cells toward bone formation — Cell reports (DOI: 10.1016/j.celrep.2026.117932)
- [Gum bacteria in the bloodstream: a fresh signal for coronary risk](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/combined-oral-and-peripheral-blood-detection-of-porphyromonas-gingivalis-associa-42602466): In brief: Oral P. gingivalis positivity was independently associated with higher CHD prevalence in this angiography cohort (PR 1.24). — Journal of oral microbiology (DOI: 10.1080/20002297.2026.2712022)
- [HbA1c outpredicts every other glycemic marker for periodontitis severity](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/association-between-glycemic-parameters-and-severity-of-periodontitis-in-nepal-a-42569004): In brief: FBG, PPBS, and HbA1c all worsened stepwise with periodontitis severity in 396 patients (p<0.001). — International journal of dentistry (DOI: 10.1155/ijod/3153277)
- [Keratinized mucosa, not vestibule depth, protects peri-implant tissue](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/association-of-vestibule-depth-with-peri-implant-inflammation-and-soft-tissue-st-42596709): In brief: In 129 single-implant patients, adequate KMW (≥2 mm) correlated with greater VD, thicker mucosa, and less recession — but the two measures are… — Journal of periodontal & implant science (DOI: 10.5051/jpis.2503220161)
- [Systemic conditions didn't predict implant loss over 11 years](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/the-success-of-dental-implants-in-patients-with-systemic-conditions-a-retrospect-42551058): In brief: Across 1,872 implants (602 patients), success was statistically identical between systemically healthy (96.76%) and compromised (97.60%)… — Journal of cranio-maxillo-facial surgery (DOI: 10.1016/j.jcms.2026.109839)
- [Nonsurgical EMD matched surgery for intrabony defects in this RCT](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/clinical-and-radiographic-comparison-of-minimally-invasive-nonsurgical-and-surgi-42596714): In brief: In a 3-arm RCT (n=60), nonsurgical EMD application achieved outcomes statistically indistinguishable from EMD-assisted minimally invasive… — Journal of periodontal & implant science (DOI: 10.5051/jpis.2505660283)
- [Severe Periodontitis Flags Hidden Coronary Risk](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/periodontitis-epicardial-adipose-tissue-and-coronary-events-the-swedish-cardio-42555521): In brief: Severe periodontitis (6% of 29,056 adults) was associated with higher coronary calcium levels (an indication of atherosclerosis). — European Heart Journal (DOI: 10.1093/eurheartj/ehag569)
- [Tooth Loss Tracks With Blood Markers of Neurodegeneration](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/edentulism-blood-based-neurodegenerative-biomarkers-and-10-year-dementia-risk-42555275): In brief: In 4,238 US adults 50+, edentulism predicted a 49% higher risk of cognitive impairment and 28% higher risk of dementia over 10 years — Alzheimer's & Dementia (DOI: 10.1002/alz.71731)
- [Membrane Stiffness May Shape Early GBR Healing, Not the Outcome](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/do-collagen-membranes-with-different-thickness-related-mechanical-properties-aff-42545380): In brief: Preclinical (beagle) model compared two collagen membranes with different thickness/stiffness in lateral bone augmentation — Clinical Oral Investigations (DOI: 10.1007/s00784-026-07051-y)
- [Donor-Derived Dentin Matches Xenograft in Sinus Lift](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/effect-of-allogenic-demineralized-dentin-matrix-vs-xenograft-in-maxillary-sinus-42558098): In brief: Randomized split-mouth trial (n=9, bilateral sinus augmentation) comparing allogenic demineralized dentin matrix (ADDM) vs xenograft — Journal of Advanced Periodontology & Implant Dentistry (DOI: 10.34172/japid.026.3985)
- [Hyaluronic Acid Boosts Early Stability in Immediate Implants](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/clinical-and-radiographic-evaluation-of-natural-bovine-bone-with-hyaluronic-acid-42562852): In brief: RCT, 16 immediate implants: bovine bone + hyaluronic acid vs unfilled fresh socket (control) — Scientific Reports (DOI: 10.1038/s41598-026-64165-9)
- [Periodontitis and diabetes: the risk really does run both ways](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/oral-health-and-diabetes-a-systematic-review-and-meta-analysis-42480567): In brief: Periodontitis at baseline predicted 18-25% more newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes over follow-up. — The Lancet Public Health (DOI: 10.1016/S2468-2667(26)00149-0)
- [A new cellular hub behind bone loss in periodontitis](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/targeting-ifn-i-driven-tertiary-lymphoid-structures-halts-b-cell-mediated-bone-l-42503518): In brief: Ectopic immune structures (tertiary lymphoid structures) form in gingiva as inflammation worsens and track with worse surgical outcomes. — International Journal of Oral Science (DOI: 10.1038/s41368-026-00450-7)
- [Leftover pockets after perio therapy don't stay quiet at implants](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/residual-periodontal-pockets-at-implant-placement-as-risk-indicator-for-peri-imp-42515938): In brief: Four cohort studies (1-23 year follow-up) consistently linked residual periodontal pockets after therapy to higher peri-implantitis rates. — Clinical Implant Dentistry and Related Research (DOI: 10.1111/cid.70174)
- [Zirconia implants: low peri-implantitis rates, at least short-term](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/prevalence-of-peri-implantitis-around-zirconia-implants-a-systematic-review-and-42516003): In brief: Pooled peri-implantitis prevalence around zirconia implants was 2% up to 5 years, rising to 8% beyond 5 years (wide CI). — Clinical Implant Dentistry and Related Research (DOI: 10.1111/cid.70176)
- [Even routine antibiotic prophylaxis leaves a mark on the microbiome](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/evolution-of-the-fecal-and-oral-microbiota-after-prophylactic-antibiotics-admini-42524765): In brief: A single prophylactic antibiotic course before dental surgery significantly disrupted oral and gut microbial diversity, peaking at days 3-10. — Journal of the American Dental Association (DOI: 10.1016/j.adaj.2026.04.020)
- [What AI Can (and Can't Yet) See on a Peri-Implantitis X-Ray](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/artificial-intelligence-for-radiographic-diagnosis-of-peri-implantitis-a-compre-42452670): In brief: Ten qualifying studies show AI models (YOLO, U-Net, ResNet, etc.) can localize implants, detect marginal bone loss, and classify severity on… — Journal of Clinical Medicine (DOI: 10.3390/jcm15135210)
- [Two Oral Protozoa Track Closely With Peri-Implant and Periodontal Disease](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/the-association-between-trichomonas-tenax-and-entamoeba-gingivalis-and-periimpla-42467269): In brief: T. tenax and E. gingivalis were detected far more often at diseased sites (periodontitis, peri-implantitis) than at healthy sites, on both… — Clinical Oral Investigations (DOI: 10.1007/s00784-026-07036-x)
- [A Cheap Adjunct That Cut Post-Op Pain — Pilot RCT on Local Insulin](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/clinical-and-radiographic-evaluation-of-local-application-of-insulin-versus-hyal-42474735): In brief: In this pilot RCT (n=21, 7/group), insulin, HA, and collagen sponge alone all improved CAL and PPD equally at 6 months in intrabony defects… — Clinical Oral Investigations (DOI: 10.1007/s00784-026-07015-2)
- [Thin Gingival Phenotype Emerges as the Strongest Peri-Implant Risk Signal in a 968-Implant Cohort](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/patient-and-implant-level-factors-associated-with-peri-implant-diseases-a-retr-42482032): In brief: In 968 implants (199 patients), 26.4% showed some degree of peri-implant disease (17.9% mucositis, 8.5% peri-implantitis). — BMC Oral Health (DOI: 10.1186/s12903-026-09338-8)
- [Bone Type and Zirconia Choice Both Move the Needle in All-on-4 Outcomes](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/medium-term-clinical-outcomes-of-the-all-on-4-system-in-different-bone-types-a-42472808): In brief: In 1,000 All-on-4 implants (250 patients), overall survival was 94.8%, dropping to 89.1% in low-density Type 4 bone versus 98.3% in dense Type 1… — BMC Oral Health (DOI: 10.1186/s12903-026-09299-y)
- [Wide-diameter implants: failure risk shifts with time after placement](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/failure-of-wide-diameter-dental-implants-predominantly-5-0-mm-show-distinct-risk-42466869): In brief: 97.5% overall survival across more than 12,000 implants ≥5.0 mm followed for up to 10 years. — Clinical implant dentistry and related research (DOI: 10.1111/cid.70173)
- [Sleep apnea and periodontitis: a plausible link resting on weak evidence](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/obstructive-sleep-apnea-and-periodontitis-a-systematic-review-with-consideration-42460466): In brief: 70% of included studies (14/20) report a significant association between OSA and periodontitis. — Acta odontologica Scandinavica (DOI: 10.2340/aos.v85.46512)
- [It's not the penicillin allergy — it's the alternative antibiotic chosen](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/self-reported-penicillin-allergy-alternative-antibiotics-and-implant-outcomes-a-42454622): In brief: Across 374 implants, early failure was 6.1% and surgical complications 8.0%. — Clinical implant dentistry and related research (DOI: 10.1111/cid.70169)
- [Fewer teeth, same accuracy: a faster way to score plaque](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/partial-mouth-plaque-recording-revisited-evaluation-of-tooth-and-surface-based-s-42461408): In brief: An optimized 12-surface subset reproduces full-mouth plaque scores almost perfectly (ICC 0.962). — Clinical oral investigations (DOI: 10.1007/s00784-026-07024-1)
- [Triangular-neck implants perform well — but nobody has compared them head-to-head](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/one-year-marginal-bone-loss-and-survival-rate-of-triangular-neck-dental-implants-42432278): In brief: Pooled analysis of 5 studies shows mean 1-year marginal bone loss of just 0.35 mm. Pooled implant survival rate is 97.8%. — International journal of implant dentistry (DOI: 10.1186/s40729-026-00702-5)
- [At 25 years, peri-implantitis doubles — the lesson from the Bern cohort](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/long-term-incidence-of-peri-implant-conditions-25-year-results-of-the-bernese-p-42423273): In brief: Implant survival 94.0% and success 90.8% at 25 years — but peri-implantitis rises from 3.5% to 9.1% (implant level) and 10% to 18.1% (patient… — Clinical implant dentistry and related research (DOI: 10.1111/cid.70171)
- [L-PRF in intrabony defects: a real 1.1 mm gain, but evidence stays weak](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/efficacy-of-leukocyte-and-platelet-rich-fibrin-l-prf-as-an-adjunct-to-open-fla-42426686): In brief: 23 RCTs pooled: L-PRF+OFD vs OFD alone at 9 months 1.11 mm PPD reduction and 1.13 mm CAL gain, statistically significant — BMC oral health (DOI: 10.1186/s12903-026-09163-z)
- [Short implants vs vertical GBR: the 8-year model favors the simpler choice](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/cost-effectiveness-of-short-implants-6-8-5-mm-compared-to-regular-length-impla-42432636): In brief: 8-year microsimulation model: short implants (6-8.5mm) without GBR vs regular (>10mm) with vertical GBR — BMC oral health (DOI: 10.1186/s12903-026-09152-2)
- [Immediate implants in diabetics survive — but bone pays the price of glycemic control](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/safety-and-feasibility-of-immediate-implant-placement-in-diabetic-patients-a-sy-42388444): In brief: Meta-analysis of 10 studies (1,350 patients, 1,623 implants): implant survival does NOT differ between diabetics and healthy patients,… — Biomedical reports (DOI: 10.3892/br.2026.2173)
- [A statin as antibiotic adjuvant: flushing out P. gingivalis hiding inside host cells](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/p-gingivalis-host-interactions-direct-antibiotic-adjuvants-for-periodontitis-an-42425934): In brief: P. gingivalis invades host cells and evades extracellular antibiotics, fueling recurrence — International journal of oral science (DOI: 10.1038/s41368-026-00448-1)
- [At 20 years implants hold up like natural teeth — but only with maintenance](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/correlation-between-periodontal-parameters-at-teeth-and-implants-an-up-to-20-yea-42320591): In brief: Over 20 years, implants and contra-lateral teeth showed comparable attachment loss (~4.5 vs ~4.4 mm) and survival in maintained periodontitis… — Journal of dentistry (DOI: 10.1016/j.jdent.2026.106848)
- [Antibiotics add half a millimetre in peri-implantitis — local beats systemic](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/efficacy-of-adjunctive-antibiotics-compared-to-non-antibiotic-therapies-followin-42348534): In brief: Across 22 RCTs, adjunctive antibiotics improved PPD by ~0.69 mm and CAL by ~0.55 mm over debridement alone — statistically significant,… — PloS one (DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0352311)
- [Xenogeneic blocks match autogenous bone at 4 years — except in the esthetic zone](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/clinical-outcomes-of-implants-in-atrophic-ridges-augmented-with-collagenated-xen-42339863): In brief: At 4 years, collagenated xenogeneic and autogenous bone blocks gave comparable implant survival and success after lateral ridge augmentation. — Brazilian oral research (DOI: 10.1590/1807-3107bor-2026.vol40.030)
- [Fascia lata allograft thickens peri-implant mucosa without a palatal harvest](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/fascia-lata-allograft-versus-subepithelial-connective-tissue-graft-for-peri-impl-42337524): In brief: In a 16-patient pilot RCT, fascia lata allograft and connective tissue graft both significantly increased peri-implant mucosal thickness and… — BMC oral health (DOI: 10.1186/s12903-026-08829-y)
- [Patients on Ozempic-class drugs: a risk modifier in perio, not a treatment](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/glp-1-receptor-agonists-in-periodontology-mechanisms-clinical-evidence-and-impli-42352323): In brief: GLP-1 receptor agonists may affect periodontal tissues both indirectly (glycemic control, weight, inflammation) and directly (GLP-1R / DPP-4… — Biomolecules (DOI: 10.3390/biom16060857)
- [Past 10 cigarettes a day, GBR implants lose twice the bone](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/effect-of-smoking-intensity-on-clinical-outcomes-of-implants-placed-with-simulta-42309675): In brief: In this 5-year cohort, smokers of >10 cigarettes/day lost about twice the marginal bone (2.67 mm) of non- and light smokers (1.34-1.40 mm). — Journal of oral science (DOI: 10.2334/josnusd.26-0028)
- [PEEK or titanium mesh for the ridge? They tie once you control the graft](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/assessment-of-two-treatment-protocols-using-prebent-titanium-mesh-and-customized-42298522): In brief: RCT in 14 patients (28 sites): no significant difference in horizontal bone gain between prebent titanium mesh (3.02 mm) and customized PEEK… — BMC oral health (DOI: 10.1186/s12903-026-08720-w)
- [Thin-phenotype lower recessions: the tunnel beats the envelope flap](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/a-short-term-randomized-controlled-trial-of-bilaminar-techniques-using-tunnel-ve-42304495): In brief: RCT in 59 patients (103 lower-incisor sites, thin phenotype): at 6 months the tunnel + CTG gave 79% mean root coverage vs 58% for the envelope… — Head & face medicine (DOI: 10.1186/s13005-026-00631-z)
- [Putting a number on periodontitis as cardiovascular risk: a proposed score](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/periodontal-inflammation-a-clinically-significant-and-underrecognized-cardiovasc-42292687): In brief: A narrative review proposing the Endothelial Risk Score (ERS): it combines Periodontal Inflamed Surface Area (PISA) with age, sex, systolic BP,… — American heart journal plus : cardiology research and practice (DOI: 10.1016/j.ahjo.2026.100808)
- [Oral disease leads NCD prevalence — and periodontal disability rises with wealth](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/the-burden-of-oral-disorders-in-latin-america-and-caribbean-countries-from-1990-42290709): In brief: In 2023, oral disorders in Latin America and the Caribbean caused 308 million prevalent cases and 2.41 million years lived with disability —… — Lancet regional health. Americas (DOI: 10.1016/j.lana.2026.101517)
- [GBR membranes: a 26% complication rate forces a rethink beyond passive occlusion](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/design-and-applications-of-barrier-membranes-for-guided-bone-regeneration-42220644): In brief: A meta-analysis of 100 studies puts GBR complication rates near 26%, exposing the structural limits of conventional collagen and PTFE membranes. — Bioactive Materials (DOI: 10.1016/j.bioactmat.2026.05.008)
- [Augmented vs native posterior mandible: which bone hosts healthier implants at 15 years?](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/outcomes-of-dental-implants-placed-in-horizontally-augmented-or-native-posterior-42225503): In brief: Implant survival was nearly identical at 15 years: 94.7% in native bone, 95.3% in augmented bone. — International Journal of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery (DOI: 10.1016/j.ijom.2026.05.015)
- [Peri-implantitis debridement: less than 1 mm cleaned in this SEM cohort](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/guidelines-for-the-depth-of-surface-decontamination-during-peri-implantitis-trea-42252880): In brief: SEM analysis of 49 explanted implants found a mean contaminant-free zone of just 0.66 mm (range 0–3.0 mm). — Journal of Periodontal & Implant Science (DOI: 10.5051/jpis.2501940097)
- [Perio therapy as CVD prevention: cost-effective only over a lifetime horizon](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/cost-effectiveness-analysis-of-non-surgical-periodontal-treatment-to-prevent-str-42271428): In brief: Over a 25-year horizon, NSPT reached an ICER of €19,322/QALY — within NICE thresholds; at 10 years the ICER more than doubled to €49,847. — Cost Effectiveness and Resource Allocation (DOI: 10.1186/s12962-026-00786-1)
- [EMD at 30: where the evidence holds — and where it does not](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/three-decades-of-enamel-matrix-derivative-from-dental-innovation-to-extra-oral-a-42254883): In brief: EMD remains a validated adjunct for recession coverage and intrabony defects, with consistent evidence across 30 years of literature. — International Journal of Dentistry (DOI: 10.1155/ijod/6556335)
- [Full-arch implants: what 29 Italian experts agreed on — and what it changes in practice](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/consensus-statement-on-full-arch-implant-rehabilitations-evidence-based-recommen-42194656): In brief: Four implants in the mandibular full-arch show comparable survival to six, per the consensus statements. — Journal of Clinical Medicine (DOI: 10.3390/jcm15103695)
- [Regeneration then orthodontics: 20-year tooth survival in Stage IV periodontitis](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/long-term-outcomes-of-regenerative-periodontal-therapy-and-orthodontic-treatment-42214655): In brief: In this cohort, 89.1% estimated tooth survival at 20 years for severely compromised teeth (PPD ≥7 mm, intrabony defect, pathologic migration)… — Journal of Dentistry (DOI: 10.1016/j.jdent.2026.106799)
- [Short implants at 10 years: viable for the atrophic ridge, but survival stays below standard implants](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/ten-year-outcomes-of-short-dental-implants-6-mm-a-systematic-review-and-sensitiv-42226287): In brief: Pooled 10-year survival was 91–94% (patient/implant level); sensitivity analysis returned the more conservative 89.7–92.8%. — BMC Oral Health (DOI: 10.1186/s12903-026-08742-4)
- [Simultaneous GBR with a 3D preformed PLGA membrane: 87% bone gain maintained at 5 months, zero exposures](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/simultaneous-implant-placement-with-guided-bone-regeneration-for-horizontal-ridg-42240865): In brief: In this 21-site single-arm study, mean horizontal bone augmentation was 2.99 mm with 87.2% of hard tissue gain preserved at 5 months. — Clinical Oral Investigations (DOI: 10.1007/s00784-026-06959-9)
- [Connective Tissue Graft Under Pontics: Early Gain, Uncertain Long-Term Edge](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/volumetric-changes-at-pontic-sites-after-connective-tissue-grafting-a-systematic-42194803): In brief: CTG reliably improves ridge contour and soft-tissue volume at pontic sites in the short term. — Journal of Clinical Medicine (DOI: 10.3390/jcm15103842)
- [Full-arch implant prostheses: the implants survive, but material choice drives complication risk](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/technical-and-biological-complications-of-implant-supported-fixed-complete-dentu-42129020): In brief: Prosthesis survival was 92.3% and implant loss 4.2% over a mean 6.8 years — high reliability in this cohort. — International Journal of Implant Dentistry (DOI: 10.1186/s40729-026-00689-z)
- [Periodontal disease starts in childhood — but Asia's data can't yet prove how often](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/prevalence-of-periodontal-diseases-in-children-and-adolescents-in-asian-countrie-42178105): In brief: Gingivitis was the dominant finding across 84 studies from 24 Asian countries, with prevalence spanning under 10% to 100% — a range that… — Journal of Dentistry (DOI: 10.1016/j.jdent.2026.106790)
- [Socket Shield: FEA points to 120-150° arc as the biomechanical sweet spot for the retained fragment](https://osteoperionews.bonebenders.com/en/articles/biomechanical-effects-of-implant-root-fragment-contact-in-the-socket-shield-tech-42172860): In brief: In this finite element model, a labial arc angle of 120-150° for the retained root fragment produced the most balanced stress distribution… — International Dental Journal (DOI: 10.1016/j.identj.2026.109623)
